city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: Moncks Corner: 10.6% of residents were 65 or older (2020 census); county seat of Berkeley County; elevation 33 ft; humid subtropical, about 52.3 in of rain a year; town lies south of Lake Moultrie.

neighborhoods.value: Perry Hill (historic community split by US 52 in 1975). Wikipedia names no other neighborhoods; nearby places outside the town: Pimlico, Pinopolis, Sangaree, Russellville. Foxbank Plantation and Lewisfield Plantation appear only in realtor sources.

place_entities.value: Moncks Corner Town Hall (118 Carolina Avenue); Moncks Corner Regional Recreation Complex; Market Pavilion (farmers market); Old Santee Canal Park (Santee Canal NRHP); Santee Cooper HQ.
